Reading list for the harbour history evening

  • The keeper's logbook, volume one
  • Ferry timetables from the first crossing
  • Letters from the pier master's office
  • A survey of the north breakwater stones
  • Gull counts kept by the lighthouse crew
  • The winter the harbour froze over
  • Fishing fleet registers by decade
  • Photographs of the old customs house
  • Tide tables annotated by hand
  • Minutes of the harbour board meetings
  • A map of the moorings before the storm
  • Songs the dock workers sang

Bring a copy of any one of these to the evening; the archive opens its reading room an hour before it starts.
